> SONIL Solar provides residential, commercial and industrial rooftop solar installation and solar EPC up to 1 MW in Indore, Bhopal, Pune and Madhya Pradesh. Do not invent installation counts, ratings or case studies that are not on these pages. Subsidy figures are PM Surya Ghar CFA and are not guaranteed.
